verdict.rationale: Jitsu offers indirect control over data lifecycle rather than explicit retention or deletion features. Data lands in your own warehouse, the 'single source of truth', where you govern retention yourself. Jitsu can also be fully self-hosted, and Functions or unconnected sources can filter events out before they are stored. No documented retention-period settings, deletion API, or data-subject erasure workflow appears in the evidence. Missing for 10: configurable retention periods for Jitsu-held data (Kafka buffers, dead-letter queue, profiles), a deletion/erasure API or MCP/CLI deletion operations, documented GDPR delete-request handling, and independent corroboration.
